kind: reuse of the T0 Project Evolution projection, and what V0 conservatively quarantined
reusedImplementation: src/trajectory/projection.ts (T0, 1682 lines) — NOT modified and NOT rewritten
howReused: src/composition/trajectory_v0.ts calls composeTrajectoryInputs(...) and buildProjectTrajectory(...) exactly as T0's own composition does, then SELECTS a safe subset for the Preview.
selectionRule: a relation is selected only when (a) it is in the safe set, (b) its evidenceState is ESTABLISHED_BY_OWNER_REFERENCE, and (c) it actually touches a node whose canonical Work event belongs to the addressed attempt.

attemptSelector.usedByV0: the canonical Work event's entity_id plus its event type, project id and source digest (src/composition/trajectory_v0.ts attemptEvents())
attemptSelector.explicitlyNotUsed: node.label.includes(attemptId) — the T0 review flagged label-based Attempt lookup as an incomplete guarantee, so V0 does not rely on it for the canonical selection
attemptSelector.note: T0's own projection still builds its node set the same way; V0 does not change that. V0 simply does not use the label to SELECT an attempt.

historicalVsCurrent.measured: present in every Preview built by the composition adapter, asserted by test

noT0Overhaul.reason: §5 forbids spending this stage fixing every historical T0 issue; only the minimal exact Attempt selector was added, inside the V0 adapter.

deferredRatherThanImplemented: V0 omits a questionable Reasoning/Proof edge entirely rather than adding another T0 semantic-reconstruction framework. In the real non-model scenarios no cross-owner ground exists, so the quarantined set is empty there and the selected set contains only exactly-established Work relations.
